semantics: One entry per reusable approved material envelope/rule and revision. Concrete generated instances inside bounds are dependent traces, not fresh scientific approvals. Material changes require fresh review and history-preserving supersession.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.

Supplied current comparable work/effort exposure governs main work. No watch VO2 estimate, old/downhill result or easy pace may create a high-intensity or race target.

Ten-minute easy preparation and five-minute easy cooldown are coaching selections; allow shorter/terminated exit on response and fit all components to availability. They are not fabricated prior history.

Familiar strides mean relaxed nonmaximal efforts with prior compatible exposure and eligible current easy preparation; no maximal sprint, novel hills or uncalibrated VO2 equivalence.
